entities.summary: The Hafiz Ahmad Khan Mosque, also known as the Masjid-A-Hafiz Ahmed Khan or the Ice House Mosque, is a mosque located in the Chepauk neighbourhood of Chennai, in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. The mosque is situated next to Vivekanandar Illam on Quai-de-Millath Road, in an area also known as Ice House. and was constructed in 1818 by Hafiz Ahmad Khan, an official in Carnatic court.
